name: Product-spec-kit
headline: Product-spec-kit - AI for Product Specifications
short_description: AI-powered tool for creating, refining, and maintaining product specifications. Integrates with LLMs and IDEs to streamline documentation for product teams. Ensures consistent, high-quality specs from concept to implementation.
author: diegoeis

sections.overview:
Product Spec Kit is a comprehensive framework designed to help product teams create and maintain high-quality specifications using AI assistance. It provides structured workflows, ready-to-use templates, and validation mechanisms to ensure consistency across all documentation. The kit integrates seamlessly with LLM platforms like Claude and works with standard IDE conventions for easy adoption. Product managers and designers benefit from time-saving templates and clear processes that guide documentation from initial concept through implementation. Compatible with any LLM platform supporting Projects or Claude Skills, it streamlines the specification phase while maintaining professional standards.
Create product requirement documents (PRDs) for new AI applications and standard processes
Break down PRDs into epics, stories, and actionable tasks for development teams
Clarify and refine existing product specifications with AI guidance
Establish consistent documentation standards across multiple product teams
- **Product Name**: EcoClean Laundry Pods
- **Product Type**: Sustainable Laundry Detergent
- **Target Audience**: Eco-conscious consumers, households with children, and allergy sufferers
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/diegoeis/product-spec-kit`
sections.usage:
```
Create a comprehensive product specification for [PRODUCT_NAME], a [PRODUCT_TYPE] designed for [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Include sections for features, technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Ensure the spec aligns with [COMPANY]'s design principles and [INDUSTRY] standards.
```
Copy

```
# Product Specification: EcoClean Laundry Pods
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
